messages.subject: covariates and RILs
parts:
Hello,

I have a dataset where we have genotyped the same set of RILs in 3 different environments. Part of our interests are in environment by QTL interactions. Currently I analyze each environment differently. Would it be valid in Rqtl to analyze them together, using the environment as a covariate? If I were to do this, should I give the RILs in different environments different names (even though they would be the same genotypes).

Thanks for any advice,

Julin

messages.author: ab8dbe3bec292afe
messages.subject: Re: covariates and RILs
parts:
I don't think it is quite right to do this with environment as a
covariate,
because you'd ignore the matching of genotypes across the multiple
environments.
I think it'd be better to treat these as multiple phenotypes, but R/
qtl doesn't
have facilities for that, and so QTL Cartographer might be your best
bet.

karl
